_note: Manual v1 (2026-10-15) is the current Cannabis, Hemp, and CBD Products Program Manual for Category 25. The house DOI suffix hmtc.manual.cannabis-hemp-and-cbd-products is reserved for deposit. cert_doi stays empty until that deposit. Method edition is at /program/method.

versions.label: Manual v1
versions.summary: First Category 25 Program Manual. Six live standards. Numeric ceilings are the values on those standards. Species with no separate number are capped at the parent total and tested on every lot. Metal safety only.
